name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
Zero Annoying Popups: Completely eliminated spammy native Android toasts when clicking empty inputs, changing themes, switching quality presets, or adjusting settings.
Sleek Inline Micro-Interactions: Replaced jarring empty-input toasts with modern Apple / Google style input shake and soft red border pulses.
Native Toast De-duplication: Cancel previous toast immediately when showing notifications so toasts never stack, linger, or freeze over the bottom navigation bar.
Silent Settings & Themes: All visual changes take effect smoothly without unnecessary system banner interruptions.
